purpose: Recompute cumulative baseline and candidate scores before accepting a later shared-model stage.
review: One reviewer; two provenance findings fixed and covered by mutation tests; final review found no issues.
checks: Require English and French evaluation coverage for every retained application.
Require every frozen set, unique case and assigned worker; reject changed model/provider/driver configuration.
Recompute canonical artifact group hashes from attested file maps.
Verify completion-pinned labels, event hashes and summary hashes before scoring.
Require existing model targets for every frozen set and application.
Reject declines in retained-app tool, structure, action and eligible exact-argument counts, even when aggregate targets pass.
limitations: Temporary synthetic test fixtures verify report checks, not model performance.
Future launch controllers must independently bind the accepted predecessor, artifacts and completed result hashes.
Performance, native security, knowledge factuality and live application testing remain separate.
The current R6 training, provider and frozen evaluators were not changed.
test_environment_note: The initial system-Python suite lacked jsonschema. All 90 tests passed with the existing project virtual environment.
